_comments: PER-COMPANY PIPELINES (#327). Its own file for the same coordination reason as
`.sales-forecast-actions.json`: MetadataSync reads every dot-json here, so separate files do not
Companies are the deployment's data, so the links cannot ship as metadata. An admin runs this once
after install, and again after adding a company: a company already linked to the default pipeline
is skipped. It replaced copying the pipeline and its stages per company: one pipeline now serves
every company linked to it through PipelineCompany. Same record ID, renamed.

fields.Name: Link Default Pipeline To Companies
fields.Description: Link the default pipeline (IsDefault = 1) to every company that has no link to it, so deals for that company can use it. A failure is reported per company and does not undo the others. Re-runnable: companies already linked, actively or not, are skipped.
fields.UserPrompt: Make the default sales pipeline available to every company.
